chapter: South America and back in New York
title: Tangos and Canaro's St. Louis Blues
summary: The band learned tangos while the leading tango band played St. Louis Blues.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with and understanding Thelonious Monk

blocks.x: Did you start doing any Latin American type music?

Oh, yeah. We used to do tangos. And the funny thing, we'd do a tango sometime, and we got them down pretty good. And the tango band, which was CANERO, which was the greatest band there they had at the time, CANERO'S band was playing "St. Louis Blues".

And we used to dance on it, but we had a wonderful time. We were playing the tango, and they were playing the "St. Louis Blues". We got to know each other very well, you know. We had a wonderful time there.
